title: Advanced Access Control testing (GSoC 2014) and the accessControl add-on
description: The 2014 access control project in the Student Hall of Fame and the history of the accessControl add-on in zap-extensions.

chapters.title: June 2014: first commits
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Advanced Access Control testing (Cosmin Stefan) as a 2014 Summer GSoC project, linking the 2013 HTTP sessions wiki, whose goals include "allow users to test access control with a tool that tries to access the URLs". In zap-extensions, a commit by Cosmin Stefan-Dobrin dated 2014-06-03 is titled "Added initial structure for the AccessControlExtension". On 2014-06-09 a commit by the same name is titled "Temporary removed the AccessControl Extension to be moved to separate branch".

evidence.label: 2013 sessions wiki (linked from the Hall of Fame row)

chapters.title: 2014 to 2016: alpha add-on
chapters.text: A commit by cosminstefanxp dated 2014-11-11 is titled "Merge branch '2.4alpha' into alpha". "Fixed Access Control add-on help for wiki" is dated 2015-10-06. "Do not allow to dynamically unload Access Control" is dated 2016-04-07, and "accessControl: dynamically unload the add-on (#1521)" 2018-04-03.

chapters.title: 2019 to now
chapters.text: "accessControl: relocate to its own project" is dated 2019-04-03 and "Implement Access Control API" 2019-06-19, by mbonino. "Prepare release v6 Access Control" is dated 2020-10-06. The add-on is still in zap-extensions: the latest commit touching it is dated 2026-11-05 ("Update localized resources"), and its directory has 137 commits.
